verdict.rationale: The actions GitHub Mobile exposes in its UI (reviewing and merging PRs, triaging issues, managing Copilot agent tasks) are first-party GitHub operations. GitHub documents a REST API and a GraphQL API for creating integrations and automating workflows, plus a CLI and an MCP server covering PRs, issues and Actions. However, nothing in the evidence states UI-to-API parity, and nothing shows that mobile-surfaced features such as Agent Tasks and Copilot code review are fully scriptable. The probe also found no OpenAPI spec at the checked docs paths. missing for 10: explicit documentation of UI/API parity, evidence that Agent Tasks and Copilot review are API-accessible, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.
